Purpose of script: To check the convergence and WAIC of the models 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(ggh4x)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs$figures <- "../figures"
```

# Translate mod name to corresponding variables 
```{r}
df_modtovar <- data.frame(mod = list.files(glue("{dirs$rhats}"))) %>%
  mutate(mod = str_remove_all(mod, "rhats_"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(mod, ".rds"),
         vac = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "bmvl") ~ "l", 
                         str_detect(modtemp, "bmv3") ~ "3", 
                         str_detect(modtemp, "bmv1") ~ "1"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0("bmv",vac,"_")),
         mod_out = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "spos") ~ "spos",
                             .default = "imm"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, "spos_"),
         dat = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "seonlytemp_s08") ~ "seonlytemp_s08",
                         str_detect(modtemp, "semeth_s08") ~ "semeth_s08",
                         str_detect(modtemp, "seallsero_s08") ~ "seallsero_s08",
                         str_detect(modtemp, "seonlyseropos_s08") ~ "seonlyseropos_s08",
                         str_detect(modtemp, "sebirth_s08") ~ "sebirth_s08",
                         .default = "s08"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0(dat, "_")),
         gauss = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "gauss") ~ "gauss", 
                           .default = "gamma"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0("_", gauss)),
         mod_name = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "base") ~ "base",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_2") ~ "csi_reg_2",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_3") ~ "csi_reg_3",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_4") ~ "csi_reg_4",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_6") ~ "csi_reg_6",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "cs") ~ "cs"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0("_", mod_name)),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0("_b", mod_name)),
         pat = modtemp,
         reg = case_when(str_detect(mod_name, "csi") ~ str_remove_all(mod_name, "csi_")), 
         multi = str_detect(pat, "multi")
         ) %>%
  select(mod, pat, mod_out, mod_name, reg, dat, vac, gauss, multi) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat))
```

# Check convergence (Rhats) of the photoperiod models ==============================================
```{r}
# Check that Rhats < 1
rhats <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_rhats.rds"), dir = "", {
  bind_rows(lapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$rhats}"), full.names = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  group_by(mod) %>%
  filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1), Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1) %>%
  select(mod, Rhat_cond) %>%
  ungroup()
})

rhats %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond == FALSE)
```

# Check which coefficients were problematic for models with Rhats > 1 
```{r}
check <- FALSE
if(check) {
# Check which coefficients were problematic for models with Rhats > 1 
rhats_coef <- bind_rows(lapply(filter(rhats, Rhat_cond == FALSE)$mod, 
                 function(x) readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/rhats_{x}")))) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1)) %>%
  filter(Rhat != 1) %>%
  select(mod, coefficient, Rhat)
}

# multi_dtpa 2-6, multi_dtpw 6, multi_hib-men 2-6, multi_opv cs, 4-6, opv1 3
# multi_pertu 6, multi_strep10 cs, 2-6, multi_strep11 base, cs, 2-6, multi_strep13 base, cs,
# multi strep7 3-6,
```

# Check WAIC of the photoperiod models =============================================================

# Extract waic 
```{r}
# Read in the waic of the models that converged
waic_df <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Extract waic 
  waic_raw <- sapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$waic}")), function(x) {
      data.frame((readRDS(glue("{dirs$waic}/{x}")))$estimates) %>%
        rownames_to_column("waic_name") %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = waic_name, values_from = c(Estimate, SE), names_vary = "slowest")
     }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
     bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
     mutate(mod = str_remove_all(mod, "waic_")) %>%
     select(mod, Estimate_waic) %>%
     rename(waic = Estimate_waic) %>%
     left_join(df_modtovar, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
     left_join(rhats, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
     filter(Rhat_cond)
  
  # Compare waic to the best model
  waic_diff <- waic_raw %>%
    group_by(pat, mod_out, dat) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    summarise(comp = list(
      sapply(mod, function(x) readRDS(glue("{dirs$waic}/waic_{x}")), simplify = FALSE) %>% 
        loo_compare() %>%
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("mod") %>%
        transmute(mod, waic_diff = -2 * elpd_diff)),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    unnest(comp)
  
  waic_df <- left_join(waic_raw, waic_diff, by = join_by(mod, pat, mod_out, dat))
  return(waic_df)
})

filter(waic_df, pat == "rota")
```

# Check best model per pathogen and analysis

  rename(mod_best = mod, mod_name_best = mod_name) %>%
  select(pat, mod_out, dat, mod_name_best, mod_best)
waic_best

saveRDS(waic_best, glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicbest.rds"))

# Check best model same as other models 
```{r}
waic_df %>%
  group_by(pat, mod_out, dat) %>%
  mutate(waic_best = mod_name[waic_diff == 0],
         waic_under2 = waic_diff < 2) %>%
  select(pat, mod_out, dat, mod_name, waic_best, waic_under2) %>%
  filter(waic_under2) %>%
  arrange(mod_name) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mod_name, values_from = waic_under2) %>%
  arrange(waic_best) %>%
  filter(pat %in% c("mumps", "vzv", "dipht", "mena", "menc", "meny",
                    "strep01", "strep03", "strep04", "strep05", "strep06a", "strep06b", "strep07f", 
                    "strep09v", "strep14", "strep18c", "strep19a", "strep19f", "strep23f")) %>%
  arrange(pat)
```

# Check waic table birth week ----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
waicvacbirth_df <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicvacbirth.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Compare waic week vs birth
  waic_diff <- waic_df %>%
    filter(dat %in% c("s08", "sebirth_s08")) %>%
    group_by(pat) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    summarise(comp = list(
      sapply(mod, function(x) readRDS(glue("{dirs$waic}/waic_{x}")), simplify = FALSE) %>% 
        loo_compare() %>%
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("mod") %>%
        transmute(mod, waic_diff = -2 * elpd_diff)),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    unnest(comp)
  
  waicvacbirth_df <- left_join(select(waic_df, -waic_diff), waic_diff, by = join_by(mod, pat)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(waic_diff))
  return(waicvacbirth_df)
}) %>%
  # Only univariate models 
  filter(str_detect(pat, "multi|opv|meny", negate = TRUE), mod_out == "imm") %>%
  # Left join to main analysis for comparison
  left_join(select(filter(waic_best, dat == "s08"), pat, mod_best, mod_name_best), by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  filter(if_else(dat == "s08", mod_best == mod, TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(bestvac = waic[mod == mod_best],
         diffvac = waic - bestvac,
         mindiff = min(diffvac[diffvac != 0]),
         mincond = case_when(
           mindiff > -2 & mindiff < 2 ~ "Indistinguishable", 
           mindiff >= 2 ~ "Vaccination model better",
           mindiff <= 2 ~ "Birth model better"),
         mincond = factor(mincond, levels = c("Vaccination model better", "Indistinguishable",
                                              "Birth model better"))) %>%
  arrange(mincond)
```

# Prepare predictions data for the plot 
```{r}
pred_pldf <- filter(waic_best, str_detect(pat, "multi|opv|meny", negate = TRUE),
                    mod_out == "imm")$mod_best %>%   
  map_dfr(function(mod_id) { 
    # Model metadata
    waic_mod <- filter(waic_df, mod == mod_id) %>%
      mutate(mod_reg = if_else(str_detect(mod_name, "reg"), str_remove_all(mod_name, "csi_"), NA))
    # Read in the real data  
    dat_name <- case_when(
      str_detect(mod_id, "seonlytemp") ~ glue("dataseonlytemp_brms_{waic_mod$pat}_v{waic_mod$vac}_s08.rds"), 
      str_detect(mod_id, "semeth") ~ glue("datasemeth_brms_{waic_mod$pat}_v{waic_mod$vac}_s08.rds"),
      str_detect(mod_id, "seonlyseropos") ~ glue("dataseonlyseropos_brms_v{waic_mod$pat}_{waic_mod$vac}_s08.rds"),
      str_detect(mod_id, "seallsero") ~ glue("dataseallsero_brms_{waic_mod$pat}_v{waic_mod$vac}_s08.rds"),
      str_detect(mod_id, "sebirth") ~ glue("data_brms_{waic_mod$pat}_v{waic_mod$vac}_s08.rds"),
      .default = glue("data_brms_{waic_mod$pat}_v{waic_mod$vac}_s08.rds"))
    dat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modfit}/{dat_name}"))
    # Read in 20 predictions from the model 
    t(readRDS(glue("{dirs$pred}/pred_{mod_id}"))) %>%     # list-matrix of predictions
      as.data.frame() %>%
      select(1:20) %>%                                 # first 20 draws
      bind_cols(
        data = dat$imm_val_s1,
        imm_cutoff_s1 = dat$imm_cutoff_s1,
        imm_cutoff_min = min(dat$imm_val_s1),
        reg = if(!is.na(waic_mod$mod_reg)) dat[,waic_mod$mod_reg][[1]] else NA) %>% 
      pivot_longer(-c(reg, imm_cutoff_s1, imm_cutoff_min)) %>% 
      mutate(
        type = if_else(name == "data", "2data", "1draw"),
        mod  = mod_id)}) %>% 
  # Tidy the data frame
  left_join(distinct(waic_df, mod, mod_name, dat, pat, pat_tidy), by = join_by(mod)) %>% 
  left_join(filter(waic_best, mod_out == "imm"), by = join_by(dat, pat)) %>%
  mutate(
    reg = if_else(mod_name == "cs", "cs", reg), 
    value = case_when(pat != "rota" & value <= imm_cutoff_s1 ~ imm_cutoff_min, 
                      pat == "rota" & value <= 20 ~ 20, .default = value),
    name_draw = paste0(name, reg),
    mod_name_best_tidy = factor(
      mod_name_best, levels = c("csi_reg_6", "csi_reg_4", "csi_reg_3", "csi_reg_2", "cs", "base"), 
      labels = c("Seasonal by lat. (6)" , "Seasonal by lat. (4)" , "Seasonal by lat. (3)" , 
                 "Seasonal by lat. (2)", "Seasonal", "Base")))
```

# Plots
```{r}
# WAIC plot
fig2a <- waic_pldf_l %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    x %>%
      # Create dummy variable for the order 
      mutate(mod_name_f = tidytext::reorder_within(mod_name_tidy, -waic_diff, pat_tidy)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = waic_diff, y = mod_name_f, color = mod_name_tidy)) +
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2), color = "grey") + 
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = waic_diff)) + 
      scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC from best model") + 
      tidytext::scale_y_reordered() + 
      scale_color_viridis_d(option = "rocket", end = 0.8) + 
      facet_nested_wrap(mod_name_best_tidy+pat_tidy~., ncol = 1, scales = "free", 
                        strip.position = "right") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 0),
          axis.title.y = element_blank())
})

# Predictions plot 
fig2b <- pred_pldf_l %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    filter(x, type == "1draw") %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = value, group = name_draw, color = as.character(reg))) + 
      geom_line(stat = "ecdf", alpha = 0.1) + 
      geom_line(data = filter(x, type == "2data"), stat = "ecdf", linetype = "dashed") +  
      facet_nested_wrap(mod_name_best_tidy+pat_tidy~., ncol = 1, scales = "free", 
                        strip.position = "right", nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE) + 
      scale_x_continuous("Immunogenicity (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
      scale_y_continuous("Empirical cumulative distribution function") + 
      scale_color_viridis_d("", option = "mako", na.value = "grey50", begin = 0, end = 0.8) + 
      theme(legend.position = "none")
})
```

# Supplementary figure 3 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Find the methods
```{r}
# Read in raw semeth data 
dati_l <- list()
dati_l$semeth_s08 <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
  list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"), "semeth"), "multi", 
  negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dati_l$semeth_s08) <- sub(
  ".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v2|v3)_s08.*", "\\1", str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
  list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"), "semeth"), "multi", negate = TRUE))

patsemeth_sel <- names(dati_l$semeth_s08)

# Read in corresponding mean analyses data 
dati_l$s08 <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
    list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), 
    "s08.rds"), "datase|multi", negate = TRUE), paste(patsemeth_sel, collapse = "|")), readRDS)
names(dati_l$s08) <- sub(
  ".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v2|v3)_s08.*", "\\1", str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
    list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"), "datase|multi", negate = TRUE), 
    paste(patsemeth_sel, collapse = "|")))

# Identify semeth, method and correponding mono data
pat_meth <- lapply(dati_l, bind_rows, .id = "pat") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "dat") %>%
  distinct(dat, pat, imm_met_s1) %>%
  mutate(imm_met_s1_tidy = toupper(imm_met_s1))
```

# Plot for semeth sensitivity analyses 
```{r}
pat_sel <- unique(filter(waic_df, dat == "semeth_s08")$pat) %>%
  str_subset(str_c(c("multi", "meny"), collapse = "|"), negate = TRUE)

waic_pldf_sup <- filter(waic_pldf, pat %in% pat_sel, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08")) %>%
  left_join(pat_meth, by = join_by(pat, dat)) %>%
  mutate(col_g = if_else(pat %in% pat_sel[1:10], "1", "2")) %>%
  group_split(col_g) 
pred_pldf_sup <- filter(pred_pldf, pat %in% pat_sel, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08")) %>%
  left_join(pat_meth, by = join_by(pat, dat)) %>%
  mutate(col_g = if_else(pat %in% pat_sel[1:10], "1", "2")) %>%
  group_split(col_g)
```

```{r}
# WAIC plot
figsup3a <- waic_pldf_sup %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    x %>%
      # Create dummy variable for the order
      mutate(mod_name_f = tidytext::reorder_within(mod_name_tidy, -waic_diff, paste0(pat_tidy, dat))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = waic_diff, y = mod_name_f, color = mod_name_tidy)) +
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2), color = "grey") +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = waic_diff)) +
      scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC from best model") +
      tidytext::scale_y_reordered() +
      scale_color_viridis_d(option = "rocket", end = 0.8) +
      facet_nested_wrap(pat_tidy+imm_met_s1_tidy~., ncol = 1, scales = "free",
                        strip.position = "right") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 0),
          axis.title.y = element_blank())
})

# Predictions plot
figsup3b <- pred_pldf_sup %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    filter(x, type == "1draw") %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = value, group = name_draw, color = as.character(reg))) +
      geom_line(stat = "ecdf", alpha = 0.1) +
      geom_line(data = filter(x, type == "2data"), stat = "ecdf", linetype = "dashed") +
      facet_nested_wrap(pat_tidy+imm_met_s1_tidy~., ncol = 1, scales = "free", nest_line = TRUE,
                        strip.position = "right") +
      scale_x_continuous("Immunogenicity (log10)", trans = "log10") +
      scale_y_continuous("Empirical cumulative distribution function") +
      scale_color_viridis_d("", option = "mako", na.value = "grey50", begin = 0, end = 0.8) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
})
```

# Patch plots together 
```{r}
figsup3 <- figsup3a[[1]] + figsup3b[[1]] + figsup3a[[2]] + figsup3b[[2]] + plot_layout(ncol = 4, widths = c(1,1,1,1))

# # Save the plot
ggsave(glue("{dirs$figures}/figsup3.pdf"), figsup3, width = 12, height = 18)
```
